ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels occupying the central lobe regions and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and vertical median.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous regions on the left and right lobes; bisected by a low-intensity central column that widens into a jagged horizontal band along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 78 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; the trailing edge displays a jagged, irregular topography with multiple sharp peaks and recessed valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory tapering into sharp, upwardly-angled lateral tips (flukes are oriented vertically out of water).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, discrete low-intensity circular clusters scattered across the white field of the left lobe; one prominent cluster located in the lower-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least four distinct, near-vertical low-intensity linear marks on the white surface of the left lobe; two horizontal linear marks visible on the right lobe near the outer tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and heavy serration across the trailing edge margin, suggesting significant physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Detection of a delphinid-type dorsal fin in the mid-ground background to the right of the fluke.
